title: Glomar Explorer recovers a sunken Soviet submarine

tellings.quote: Yeah. This huge corporation, they actually recovered a sunken Soviet submarine in the 1970s and it was an incredible feat

plain: On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a researcher and author named Richard Dolan describes how, in the 1970s, a huge corporation pulled a sunken Soviet submarine up from the floor of the Pacific Ocean using a ship called the Glomar Explorer. He names the businessman Howard Hughes and a company called Global Marine Corporation as part of it, and calls the recovery an incredible feat. He tells it as an example of how much secret retrieval work the government could pull off out of sight.
